capability.zh: macOS 系统框架 / Windows 经典 Outlook；写入需确认。
capability.en: macOS system frameworks / Windows classic Outlook; writes require confirmation.

help.zh: 连接时会检查系统权限。Windows 需要经典 Outlook；新版 Outlook 不支持 COM。Linux EDS 驱动暂不可用。
help.en: Connecting checks system access. Windows requires classic Outlook; new Outlook has no COM support. Linux EDS driver is currently unavailable.

list_events.zh: 一次读取最多31天的多个日历；calendarIds可传多个ID，省略即全部可读日历，不用逐个调用。统一分页并带日历名及可写标记；nextCursor沿用同一日期与ID，calendarId仅兼容单选、不可与calendarIds同传。
list_events.en: Read up to 31 days across calendars in one call. Pass calendarIds or omit for all readable calendars; do not call once per calendar. Sorted pages include calendarName/calendarWritable; use nextCursor with the same range/IDs. Legacy calendarId is single-select only; do not combine with calendarIds.

create_event.zh: 创建不含参会人的日程；无偏移ISO时间在确认前按本机时区确定化，夏令时歧义须明确偏移。用户拒绝即未创建，不自动重试。
create_event.en: Create an event without attendees after user review. Offset-less ISO times use this computer's current time zone before review; DST ambiguity needs an explicit offset. User rejection means not created; do not retry automatically.

delete_event.zh: 删除一条日程，默认关闭
delete_event.en: Delete one event; disabled by default
